# GYMRILLAZ — Parañaque, Metro Manila

> Gymrillaz is Parañaque's premier community gym built for heavy lifting, athletic conditioning, bodybuilding, and functional fitness.

## Core Information
- **Location:** 91 Saudi Arabia St, Parañaque, 1700 Metro Manila, Philippines
- **Operating Hours:** 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM Daily (Monday through Sunday)
- **Phone:** +63 960 030 8917
- **Email:** info@gymrillaz.com
- **Website:** https://gymrillaz.com

## Rates & Memberships
- **Walk-In Day Pass:** ₱120 per visit (Full open gym access 8 AM – 9 PM)
- **Monthly Membership:** ₱1,200 per month (Unlimited daily access, no lock-in contract)

## Key Amenities & Equipment
- Hex Dumbbells up to 60 lbs & multi-angle benches
- Multi-station cable towers (dual lat pulldown, crossover, seated row)
- Plate-loaded incline leg press & squat racks
- Machine circuit (pec deck, chest press, Smith machine)
- Lockers & refreshment area
